references.text: Part of the list of cities in the inheritance of the tribe of Judah in the Negev region, providing context for the cities mentioned in verse 25.
Continues the list of cities in the Negev belonging to Judah and shows the geographical connection with the area of Hazor.
Describes the southern border of the promised land, the area where Hazor-Hadattah and Kiriath-Hesron were located.
Mentions Kiriath-Hesron (Hazor) as one of the cities where the descendants of Judah settled after the exile.
The prophecy against Moab mentions Kiriath, which may be related to the city of Kiriath-Hesron mentioned in Joshua.
